notes.title: Biryu Update is Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609591/4d41ecb5ea67fac434c0a107e5eabe651cfd6f58.png"][/img][/p][p]The wait is finally over, and we’re so sorry for the long delay! We needed extra time to make sure everything works properly and that the Biryu systems can’t be abused. But now, the update is live and ready for all adventurers level 80 and above, with the [b]maximum level cap set at 95[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]For those who are unfamiliar with Biryu, this update is packed with exciting features. Soon, you’ll be able to try your luck with the [b]Yut Nori[/b] gambling game, craft powerful new [b]Datu weapons and accessories[/b] and join epic battles in [b]Castle Siege[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Some features are currently unavailable, but don’t worry, they’ll be released step by step as we continue to fine-tune and protect them from exploits. So get ready, prepare your character, and stay sharp for when these features come online![/p][p][/p][h1]September 18th, 2025 Update Notice[/h1][p][/p][h3]Event[/h3][p]All existing accounts will receive an untradable 7-day Tikoy Pack and an Event Pranas Orb of LaNena (+50%), courtesy of LaNena.[/p][p][/p][h3]Map Release & Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Biryu map is now open[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Requiores Lv. 80. Maximum level is now 95[/p][/*][*][p]The portal to [b]Town of Biryu[/b] is now accessible from the [b]Way to Coliseum[/b] in [b]Mandara[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][p][b]Merchant Oda — Accessory Upgrade System[/b] The accessory upgrade system has been reworked. [b]Itara[/b] has been added as an upgrade material[/p][list][*][p]Itara can be crafted using Biryu materials plus Rupiah[/p][/*][*][p]Itara is required to upgrade to higher-tier accessories[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading with Itara now has a chance of success[/p][/*][/list][h3]General Changes[/h3][list][*][p]H.Q. Blue Pranas Orb is now added to the Item Mall, providing +150% Prana Boost for 4 hours[/p][/*][*][p]Quest “A Strange Eastern Country” final reward increased from 1 to 20 Ziva Pustika[/p][/*][*][p]A quest that required [b]Yut Nori[/b] play has been temporarily modified to use an alternate requirement; the original requirement will be restored in a future update[/p][/*][*][p]Removed level prefixes from the names of Adigo, Manthao, and Gato[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing NPC dialogue text across all supported languages[/p][/*][/list][h3]Temporarily Unavailable Features[/h3][p]The following features will be added step by step as we keep improving them. So don’t slack off. Make sure you’re ready, or you might get caught unprepared when these features roll out! [/p][list][*][p]Yut Nori event[/p][/*][*][p]Consignment Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Ashram storage[/p][/*][*][p]Mudha portal[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant Yuri[/p][/*][*][p]Biryu bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Castle Siege[/p][/*][*][p]Castle Siege info command[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][b]Developer notes[/b] Yeah, we know these features bring life to Biryu, and we want to assure you that everything, including Yut Nori, is working as expected. However, we’re carefully reviewing each feature to prevent any chance of player abuse. Some systems, like the Consignment Shop, are being completely reworked so that no one ends up being banned due to some abuse. Our goal is to make Biryu a place full of excitement where everyone can enjoy the game fair and square![/p][/quote]

notes.title: Biryu Update Notice
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Important Announcement Regarding the Biryu Update[/b][/h1][p][/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone,[/p][p align="start"]We have an important update regarding the release schedule for the upcoming Biryu Update.[/p][p align="start"]After careful consideration, we have made the decision to [b]postpone the release from its originally scheduled date of September 9th to September 16th.[/b][/p][p align="start"]This additional week is crucial to allow our team to conduct thorough final testing and quality assurance. Our priority is to deliver a stable, polished, and enjoyable experience for all players, and this short delay is necessary to meet the high standards we set for ourselves and that you expect from us.[/p][p align="start"]We want to assure you that this extra time will be dedicated to extensive testing to identify and resolve any potential issues. We are committed to ensuring the new content is balanced and performs smoothly across all platforms.[/p][p align="start"]We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding. We are incredibly excited for you to experience everything the Biryu Update has to offer, and we believe this short wait will be well worth it.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p align="start"]The release is now scheduled for:
[b]🗓️ New Date: Monday, September 16[/b][/p]

notes.title: Strange eastern country; new map unveiled!
notes.notes:
[p][b]A strange Eastern country[/b] has torn itself out of legend and dropped into our world—an entire new continent rising from the mist like a dragon lifting its head.[/p][p][b]Pathfinders[/b] , this is the call you were born to answer.
Sharpen every blade, string every bow, and let courage beat louder than your heart, because the gates to Biryu swing wide on that dawn and will not wait.[/p][p]Charge across petal-highways that drift on the wind, scale mountains glazed with eternal snow, slip through bamboo forests that ring like bells when danger nears. Every maple-leaf shadow might hide a spirit, every lantern-lit village could be a trap or a treasure vault. Fortune, glory, and secrets older than the moon are yours to seize, if you’re fast enough, bold enough, and alive when the sun sets.[/p][p]Miss this crossing and you’ll spend the rest of your days listening to other bards sing of Biryu’s wonders while you stare at maps that never change.[/p][p]Be there on [b]September 9 as Biryu opens[/b], or be forgotten.[/p]
